_README: Dated compliance-programme duties, filed as lead-time Asana reminder tasks by scripts/compliance-calendar.mjs (weekly Compliance Calendar workflow). Two shapes: one-off { id, title, date, leadDays } and recurring { id, title, anchor, everyMonths, leadDays } — recurring occurrences are computed from the anchor, month-end clamped. Optional on both: graceDays (default 7 — a weekly cron straddling the date still files, late but loudly), provisional: true (an external body sets the date; the task tells the owner to confirm it), owner, notes[]. A duty is due inside [occurrence − leadDays, occurrence + graceDays]; each occurrence is filed once, deduped by exact task title (which embeds the occurrence date). EDIT THIS FILE to move a provisional date or add duties the repository cannot know (EWRA refresh anniversary, goAML registration renewal, licence renewals) — never the workflow.

events.title: Rotate ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN (GitHub secret + Netlify env)
notes: This token powers EVERY delivery path: daily screening, freshness/currency alarms, briefs, reconciliations — expiry or revocation without rotation reds the whole control estate on the same day.

Generate a new PAT in the Asana developer console, update the ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN repository secret (GitHub -> Settings -> Secrets and variables -> Actions) AND the Netlify site environment variable, then dispatch 'Asana Delivery Verify (manual)' to prove the path end-to-end.
Revoke the old token only after the verify run passes.

events.title: Rotate ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (GitHub secret + Netlify env)
notes: Used by the daily screening's LLM triage and the deployed advisor functions.

Create the replacement key in the Anthropic console, update the GitHub repository secret and the Netlify environment variable, then confirm the next daily screening run stays green (AI: risk-rated line present in its log) before revoking the old key.
